objective:
Distribute a cell suspension across three wells of the plate.
Move the container_02 tube to container_02_work and the plate to operation_zone. Mix the suspension on the vortex station for 5 s. With one fresh P1000 tip, transfer 500 uL of suspension into each of wells A1, A2 and A3, then discard the tip in waste. Move the plate to waiting_zone, leave it for 60 s, and finally move it to completion_zone.
operating_notes: Report finish once the plate is on completion_zone.
